design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (gift_registry_services, env_0061). 
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 4]}. The root problem registry_ext_completion_redemption takes 6 factors, the prerequisite registry_ext_missed_rewards_accrual takes 4. Task 1's draw is {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "factor_counts": [4, 4]}.
[Scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing. Claimed here: registry_ext_completion_redemption (subject registry_completion_purchase, tool redeem_completion_discount_f7189a88, owner=user) and registry_ext_missed_rewards_accrual (subject registry_rewards_accrual, tool book_rewards_accrual_4ec6fd92, owner=agent). Left for task 1: registry credit for returned gifts (registry_return_credit) and the spending of registry credit (registry_credit_use), a disjoint tree of their own. Scope constraint recorded honestly: among the claimed event types only the completion purchase and the return credit carry a tiered money computation the compute engine can read (a later gift link's amount lives on a guest's purchase record, which compute cannot reach; item adds and date changes carry no tiered number), so the two remaining problems of the difficulty use registry-category events outside the claim list (rewards accrual here, credit use in task 1); both write only registry tables.
[Why a good test] The caller asks for one thing — her completion discount on an app order line. The number is the product of six record-driven rules (item entry timing, card on the line, Finch Circle tier, registry perk from net rewards, days since the event, sale markdown better-of) over the registry ledger, the order record, the card account and the membership, and it is only correct after the agent notices, from the prerequisite sentence and the ledger, that the most recent guest gift entry has no rewards accrual, books it with its own four-factor computation, and lets the higher net rewards move the perk step. A reader of the computation document alone gets 65.80; skipping the accrual gives 45.03; gold is 52.81.
[Problem-tree card] Root registry_ext_completion_redemption <- registry_ext_missed_rewards_accrual. Edge: kind value_input, gate perk_pct, form state, policy_source "The completion discount on an order line is fixed only after every guest gift entry on a registry whose type earns registry rewards carries its registry rewards accrual entry." Four-point test: ordering connective "only after" (affirmative; a charge-like result is "fixed only after" what it rests on); record-visible state (accrual entries per guest gift entry, as find_registry_events shows them); no tool, id or code token; scope exactly the condition (every gift entry of a rewards-earning registry). Exactly one write of this difficulty creates a registry_rewards_accrual entry: book_rewards_accrual_4ec6fd92, whose rule books the accrual owed on the most recent guest gift entry lacking one. Derivation: sentence + ledger (12 gift entries, 11 accruals; missing one is initial_state.registry_events.<gift 2026-08-28> purchase 548.00) + the accrual policy's rule -> one action, booking that accrual. Unresolved at frozen_time: registry_rewards_balance 535.67 = sum of 11 accruals; flips to true when step 9 books 62.88 (balance 598.55). Deletion sensitivity (actual run): skipping step 9 -> perk step 2 instead of 4 -> discount 45.03 instead of 52.81. Topological order: accrual (step 9) then redemption (step 11). Owner=user problem: the redemption is the registrant's own act on her own order line, handed over after the agent states the amount. user_scenario never mentions rewards, accruals or the gift; tools validate nothing (both function bodies only create/post rows).
[Base-invariant card] registry_completion_discount.completion_status: "The registry is in completion status." — initial_state.registries.status = completion (period opened 2026-08-15, ends 2027-02-11), bound to the tool's status argument. registry_agg_per_registry_balances: policy_scope (one registry). registry_rewards_rules: payout_status applies to payouts only; accrual is policy_scope; payout date 2026-10-14 not yet reached, so the accrual is before payout. No time gate applies to either write.
[Business-object card] Target object of the root: purchase 40391740 (Staub 7-qt Round Cocotte, sku 41820736, status ordered, app, sale 329.00 / regular 389.00, charged to World Elite Mastercard ending 4491). Excluded: the completed towel set purchase 40388215 (already carries its completion entry of 36.00). Rows in the quantity count: item entries of 41820736 (2026-03-02 qty 1, 2026-08-29 qty 2), one guest gift of 41820736 (2026-06-12), no completion entry of it. Target of the prerequisite: the guest gift entry of 2026-08-28 (548.00, Le Creuset 7-Piece Cookware Set); the other 11 gifts already carry accruals.

[Factor card — completion redemption (6)] item_entry_percent (parameter): ladder <min days -> none / most recent item entry after event date (and not fewer than the minimum days) -> post-event item share, half of the type percent (Wedding: 10) / otherwise type percent 20; world: most recent entry 2026-08-29 (raise to qty 2), 45 days before purchase -> 10; near-miss: first entry 2026-03-02 is before the event and would give 20; baseline result 91.71. elite_card_tier_bonus (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty card): active AND Store Card Elite/World Elite -> 8 / other active M&F card -> the greater of the type card bonus (Wedding 5) and the standard card bonus 3 / 0; world: line charged to active World Elite (the 2016 Store Card is closed); baseline 21.69. circle_tier_bonus (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty loyalty): type grants bonus AND active Icon -> 10 / AND active Platinum or Diamond -> 5 / 0; world Platinum active since 2025-02-01 upgrade; baseline 33.36. net_rewards_perk (parameter, history): net accruals less reversals >= 550 -> 4 / >= 300 -> 2 / 0; world after step 9: 598.55 -> 4 (535.67 before -> 2); baseline 37.25. early_window_bonus (parameter, date): <= 30 days after event -> 4 / 31-60 -> 2 / 0; world 59 days -> 2; baseline 45.03. markdown_better_of (method, cross-difficulty order): clearance/doorbuster/final sale or an excluded class (Fine Jewelry & Watches, Designer Handbags & Luxury) -> none / otherwise sale or coupon markdown -> percent on regular price less markdown, floor 0 (better-of) / otherwise percent on selling price; world Home & Kitchen sale line -> 0.29 x 389.00 - 60.00 = 52.81; baseline 95.41. Whole baseline (20% of 329.00) = 65.80.
[Factor card — missed rewards accrual (4)] post_event_gift_cut (parameter): > 30 days after event -> type 10 - 5 / after event -> 10 - 2 / type 10; world gift 13 days after -> 8; baseline 73.36. cardholder_rewards_bonus (parameter, cross-difficulty card): holds an active Elite/World Elite account -> 2 / holds no elite but another active M&F account -> 1 / 0 (tested by account existence, so a second active account cannot change the tier); world 2; baseline 52.40. guest_gift_total_bonus (parameter, history): guest gift entries total >= 4,500 -> 2 / >= 2,000 -> 1 / 0; world 4,925.00 -> 2; baseline 52.40. large_gift_taper (method): >= 500 -> full percent on 500 plus half on the excess / < 25 -> none / percent on the whole; world 548.00 -> 60.00 + 2.88 = 62.88; baseline 65.76. Whole baseline (10% of 548) = 54.80. Seeded accruals were computed with the same rule at their dates (type 10 + elite 2 + the gift-total step then reached, taper above 500), so the history teaches the charter.
[Overwrites] Completion redemption retires three registry_completion_discount sentences (the percent composition, the selling-price/coupon sentence, the min-days/quantity sentence), each replaced_by naming its scope (order lines this policy handles; every other completion purchase stays under base) and carrying the still-in-force parts (rounding half up, quantity coverage, coupon never-both). The accrual policy retires the base accrual sentence for every guest gift accrual, keeping rounding and the zero-percent rule.
[Seed rationale] registry row (Wedding, completion, event 2026-08-15, rewards balance 535.67); 15 item entries; 12 guest gift entries (guest checkout purchases, customer not on file, linked to the registry, completed); 11 accruals; 1 completion entry (towel, 36.00 under base 30%); registrant purchases (towel completed, cocotte ordered); World Elite (active) and Store Card (closed) accounts; Platinum membership. Every row is read by a gold read (replay closure 58/58).
[Persona] Celeste Okafor, relaxed and chatty; opening: completion discount on her app order line today; identity by mobile 5035550142 and DOB 1993-04-17 only when asked; registry number, order number and card ending only when asked; agrees passively if told something on the registry must be put right first; runs the redemption when handed over and ends the call; never proposes a number.
[Standard solution & verification] Reads: find_customers, verify_customer_identity, find_registries, find_registry_events, find_purchases(customer), find_purchases(registry), find_card_accounts, find_loyalty_memberships; writes: unlock+call book_rewards_accrual_4ec6fd92 (rewards_amount 62.88 on the 2026-08-28 gift), unlock+call(user) redeem_completion_discount_f7189a88 (status completion, purchase 40391740 line, sku 41820736, discount_amount 52.81). Verification: /tmp scratch verify script mirroring check_compute printed ACC (62.88, {post_event_gift_cut 73.36, cardholder 52.4, guest_gift_total 52.4, taper 65.76}, 54.8) and A (52.81, {item_entry 91.71, elite_card 21.69, circle 33.36, perk 37.25, early 45.03, markdown 95.41}, 65.8), A without the accrual 45.03. Gates run: check_extended / check_task_tools / replay_tasks / check_solvability / check_compute / check_grounding / check_cross_fire --task 0 all OK.
[Revisions] (1) tuple membership tests rejected by the sandbox -> rewritten as or-chains. (2) replay closure mismatch and empty-string foreign keys -> guest customers, unread order/card ledgers and the returned Dyson gift removed, empty FKs set to null, find_purchases(registry) added. (3) check_compute: accrual history not load-bearing (only LATEST read) -> Finch Circle rewards bonus replaced by the guest gift total bonus (SUM over gift entries); seeded accruals recomputed (balance 535.67); perk upper threshold set to 550 so the accrual moves the perk step. (4) solvability intent_source kinds corrected.
[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the completion KB (baseline + six factor documents), the find_* returns and the persona, a careful agent reaches: registry in completion; prerequisite sentence demands accruals on every gift; one gift lacks it -> book 62.88; then 29% better-of on the sale line -> 52.81. No second reading found: the most-recent-entry rule pins item timing, the card on the line (not the closed card) pins the card bonus, and the better-of sentence pins the sale treatment.

[Rework round 2] Audit T0-1: evaluation_criteria[3] objective no longer claims a reversal (none exists on this registry) and [7] necessity no longer claims a circle rewards bonus (the accrual reads no Finch Circle input). Charter changes that touch this task without moving its gold: the completion redemption now excludes Fine Jewelry & Watches and Designer Handbags & Luxury lines in the no-discount tier (G-5); the post-event item value is half the type percent and the standard-card tier is the greater of the type card bonus and the standard card bonus, so no tier repeats its fall-through on any registry type (G-8); every ladder states its precedence; the missed accrual tests the elite and the other active card by account existence (G-6) and states that a gift already carrying a reversal is not accrued (G-3). Re-run on this world: rewards_amount 62.88 and discount_amount 52.81 unchanged; factor sensitivities unchanged.
[Rework round 3 — renderer source mismatches] The completion Finch Circle bonus is now anchored, in rule and ladder, to the tier held on the date the completion discount is redeemed, which is the date of the completion purchase entry; the compute reads the membership as it stands at redemption, so both faces say the same thing. On this world the last tier change precedes the redemption. The sale/markdown tier now reads 'a sale price, or a selling price below the regular price for any reason', the exact width of the compute branch. The early window's first tier names lines bought before the event date. The card bonus is read for an account active on the redemption date. The baseline sentences now stand as one continuous passage of the rule (the price-rule overwrite carries its own rounding clause), and the order-line reads list names the merchandise class. No compute changed; rewards_amount and discount_amount are unchanged.
user_scenario: You are Celeste Okafor, a 33-year-old landscape architect in Portland who married Marcus Bell on August 15 and is still working through the Marlowe & Finch Wedding Registry the two of you kept. You are relaxed, a little chatty, and you like to understand a number before you accept it. This morning, on 2026-10-13, you ordered the Staub 7-qt Round Cocotte in Grenadine in the Marlowe & Finch app; it is on sale right now, the order has not shipped, and you paid with your Marlowe & Finch World Elite Mastercard. You call because you want your registry completion discount on that app order line, today, while it is still on order. You open with that request and nothing else. When the agent asks who you are, you give your mobile number 5035550142; if a second detail is wanted you give your date of birth, 1993-04-17. If asked for your email it is celeste.okafor@fastmail.com and your billing ZIP is 97214. Only if the agent asks: the registry number is R40817263, the app order number is 40391740, and the card you paid with ends in 4491. You know you are a Finch Circle member at Platinum but you do not remember your member number, and you say so if asked. You have no idea what the discount comes to and you never suggest a figure or a percent. If the agent explains that something on the registry has to be put right before your discount can be worked out and asks whether that is all right, you say that is fine and they may go ahead. When the agent tells you the discount and hands you the step to redeem it yourself, you carry it out exactly with the details the agent gives you and read back what it confirms. If the agent's figure sounds odd to you, you only ask them to double-check it against your registry; you never offer a figure of your own. Once the redemption is confirmed you thank the agent and end the call; you do not raise anything else.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's customer profile by the mobile number she gives.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed by her customer reference; identity cannot be checked without the profile.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Confirm the caller with two matching details before any registry figure is discussed.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must be confirmed before any account information is discussed or any change is made.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Wedding Registry: type, completion status, event date 2026-08-15 and its registry reference.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Status completion is the base gate; the registry type sets the completion discount percent (and the post-event item share of it), the cap, the minimum days on the registry, the type card bonus compared with the standard card bonus, and the Finch Circle bonus grant; the event date anchors the early-completion window and the post-event item rule.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read every registry entry: item entries, guest gift entries, rewards accrual entries (there is no rewards reversal entry on this registry), and the earlier completion purchase entry.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows the prerequisite is unmet (the most recent guest gift entry of 2026-08-28 carries no accrual, which the completion discount waits on), and supplies the item entry dates and quantities, the gift count of the item, the net registry rewards for the perk and the cap already used.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the registrant's purchase records and pick the order line still in ordered status.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The order line gives the selling price, regular price, sale price type, merchandise class (not an excluded class), item number, purchase date and the card account it is charged to.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the card account the order line is charged to and the registrant's active card.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The active World Elite Mastercard sets the elite card completion bonus on the line and the elite holder rewards bonus of the accrual; the closed Store Card is not an active account.
